nodes.title: Image / Keyframe Conditioning
widgets_values:
integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] Clean, natural continuation of the source video background and subject without any wires, ropes, straps, or unwanted objects in the masked region. Preserve the exact original camera trajectory, lighting, textures, skin/cloth details, shadows, depth of field, motion timing, and every pixel outside the white mask. Seamlessly reconstruct the occluded background and surface texture inside the masked area with temporally consistent detail.

overall_soundscape:
Preserve the source audio exactly. Generate no replacement sound.

widgets_values:
0.7 • 0.6 CATALOG • Masked Video Inpaint

1. Install models and extra packs listed in example_workflows/README.md.
2. Copy the supplied assets to ComfyUI/input; select source media where requested.
3. Set a unique project run name, then edit scenes and the Generation Profile.
4. Follow the numbered columns left → right and inspect the saved results.

Recovery is disabled by default. Enable it only to assemble saved clips without sampling.
